note: Hand-maintained Japanese sets that TCGdex does not carry (promo series). snapshot-tcgdex.py merges these into data/tcgdex/sets-ja.json on every '--lang ja' run, AFTER the TCGdex list is built, so they survive the weekly catalog refresh. If TCGdex ever gains one of these sets, the TCGdex entry wins and the custom entry is skipped. Per-set snapshot shells are created under data/tcgdex/sets/ja/<id>.json when missing (never overwritten). The PkmnPrices pipeline (ja-pkmn-enrich.py -> ja-pkmn-build-cards.py -> ja-price-backfill.py) fills cards, images/names, and prices from the PkmnPrices set ids in ja-pkmn-enrich.py OVERRIDES. Totals are PkmnPrices card counts; these promo series are closed, so counts are stable. English display names live in ja-set-names.json (single source of truth).
